Prevention: Maintain proper sanitation: remove dried leaves, unproductive/old plant, suckers and weeds.
Plant healthy suckers from registered nursery having no history of banana stem weevil or tissue culture plantlets.
Maintain no more than 3 plantlets of banana in one pit while establishing the orchard.
Maintain proper spacing; follow varietal recommendation.
Remove whole plants after harvesting fruits.
Monitoring: Monitor pseudostem of the plant weekly for small holes and jelly exudation.
Observe other symptoms like yellowing and withering of leaves, exudation of sap from leaf sheaths, decaying of peduncles and immature ripening of fruits.
Monitor for the adult weevil at the base of pseudostem.

Consider action when around 5% of plants are infested; action might need to be considered at lower infestation levels in case of early infestations.
Direct Control: Remove heavily infested plants, destroy by chopping and burning.
Handpick adult weevils from plants and the chopped pseudostem baits, and destroy them.
Spray azadirachtin 0.03% EC @ 5 ml/ L water for 2-3 times at 2 week intervals.

Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Chlorpyrifos 10% GR @ 30g/ plant as soil treatment around the base of pseudostems.
Cartap hydrochloride 4% GR @ 20g /plant as soil treatment near plant base or into the whorl of plants @ 2g /plant.
